name: Sin City Boys
description: The Sin City Boys formed in 1966 at 27th and Ridgeway in Little Village in response to rival gangs — including the Latin Kings, Morgan Deuces, and Ridgeway Lords — moving into the South Lawndale area. They became close allies with the Two Six when that gang formed around 1970, though members began flipping to Two Six starting circa 1977. By 1992, remaining members relocated to the Cicero suburb, establishing sections at 12th Place and 47th and later 13th and 49th Street.
